settings.heading: CBG And CBD For Focus
settings.text:
We talk a lot about CBD here at HempLucid, and for good reason. In addition to helping us FIGHT STRESS and find DEEPER SLEEP (without next-day grogginess), CBD can help induce a state of relaxed calm that helps us feel sharp, clear, and “in the zone.” As the major non-intoxicating compound in cannabis and hemp, CBD is an all-natural all-star when it comes to helping us access better MENTAL CLARITY AND FOCUS.  


Then there’s CBG, another cannabinoid that’s attracting a lot of attention. Like CBD, CBG isn’t intoxicating, and it supports our health with anxiety-reducing, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective qualities. As THIS EARLY STUDY suggests, it’s an all-natural compound we’ll be hearing much, much more about in the years to come.

settings.heading: Mushrooms For Focus
settings.text:
As powerful as CBD and CBG are, they’re not the only compounds we lean on here at HempLucid. Since the earliest days of Chinese medicine, humans have known that adaptogens and functional mushrooms such as chaga have the potential to help us manage stress and achieve deeper focus without intoxication. And here at HempLucid, one of the mushrooms we lean most on is Lion’s Mane.  


In addition to promising data suggesting that Lion’s Mane can enhance the activities of neurotransmitters, Lion's Mane compounds have been shown to potentially INCREASE THE LEVELS OF NERVE GROWTH FACTOR (NGF) in the brain. NGF is a protein that plays an important role in the health of nerve cells, which is vital for cognitive function, memory, and concentration.

settings.heading: Plant-Powered Proprietary Focus Blend
settings.text:
Here at HempLucid, we think life is BETTER WITHOUT CHEMICALS AND SYNTHETIC DRUGS in our systems. Taken in conjunction, this “power trio” has been shown to have BRAIN-BOOSTING BENEFITS.  


In addition to being convenient (and just plain delicious), our Focus Gummies are formulated to be highly bioavailable. That’s one reason many people experience positive effects with just half a gummy a day. That said, because of the robust safety profiles of all ingredients, it’s perfectly safe to take up to two Focus Gummies a day for maximum support.

settings.title: Does CBD do anything for stress?
settings.answer: One of the top reasons people seek out CBD is to help manage stress and find more calm in their day to day lives. A number of clinical studies (and a great deal of anecdotal evidence) suggests that CBD can help relieve stress, soothe anxiety, and help us find deeper, more restorative sleep. Our CBD gummies for stress stack those benefits with adaptogenic herbs to layer the relief.

settings.title: Which mushrooms are best for stress?
settings.answer: Centuries of traditional medicine wisdom (and modern clinical studies) suggest that Lion’s Mane, reishi, and other adaptogenic mushrooms help our bodies and minds cope with the destructive side-effects of stress. We include a blend of reishi, cordyceps, Lion’s Mane, chaga and Turkey Tail in our Stress Mushroom Gummies.

settings.title: Is ashwagandha good for stress?
settings.answer: Ancient Vedic physicians believed that ashwagandha is a potent support for times of stress. Today, modern clinical research suggests this adaptogen supports memory and cognitive function, improves sleep, lowers blood sugar, and supports cardiovascular and immune health. You’ll find ashwagandha in our stress relief gummies.
